title: Chiral Anomaly, Schwinger Effect, Euler-Heisenberg Lagrangian, and application to axion inflation
authors: Valerie Domcke; Yohei Ema; Kyohei Mukaida
read_depth: Read sections 2.1–2.2, 3.3 and relevant weak-field/anomaly equations; not a claim of line-by-line audit of cosmological applications.
role: Landau normalization, separation of induced transport and vacuum polarization, charge renormalization and Euler–Heisenberg matching; identifies neglected scale-factor derivative.
limitation: Its simplified solved Landau modes set the scale-factor derivative to zero. It is not a self-consistent curved Maxwell–Dirac stress closure.

title: Vacuum polarization and pair production in time-dependent electric fields: A quantum-kinetic-equation approach
authors: I. A. Aleksandrov; V. A. Bokhan; A. I. Baksheev; A. Kudlis
read_depth: Read abstract, current/energy ultraviolet discussion and section V renormalization, including equations 120–153.
role: One-potential and Pauli–Villars charge subtraction; on-shell finite condition; common current and energy counterterms.
limitation: Spatially homogeneous electric field; it does not itself supply our constant-B Landau implementation or a curved-spacetime solver.

title: Pair production in a strong electric field: an initial value problem in quantum field theory
authors: Y. Kluger; J. M. Eisenberg; B. Svetitsky
read_depth: Read initial-value overview and adiabatic state/regularization discussion, including pages 6–14 and spinor-section entry.
role: Prior self-consistent scalar/spinor mean-field backreaction and adiabatic-state requirements.
limitation: Not a fresh reproduction of its numerical experiments; some displayed earlier sections are scalar and must not be transferred to fermions without the separate derivation.

title: Pair creation in electric fields, renormalization, and backreaction
authors: Antonio Ferreiro; Jose Navarro-Salas; Silvia Pla
read_depth: Read six-page paper through the adiabatic-order and conservation conclusions; parent researcher independently inspected pages 4–6.
role: Electromagnetic adiabatic-order ambiguity and requirement of shared stress/current renormalization in an evolving metric.
limitation: Its detailed spinor calculation is 1+1-dimensional; it bounds extensions of our flat model rather than proving a general 3+1 curved prescription.

title: Pair production due to an electric field in 1+1 dimensions and the validity of the semiclassical approximation
authors: Silvia Pla; Ian M. Newsome; Robert S. Link; Paul R. Anderson; Jose Navarro-Salas
type: Primary research paper; published arXiv v3
read_depth: Read abstract, introduction, model/approximation discussion and linear-response criterion; no claim to reproduce every figure.
role: Validity of mean-field closure can fail independently of numerical conservation; initial current preparation; perturbation diagnostic.
limitation: A 1+1-dimensional finding with specific states/drives does not prove failure or give a quantitative error bar for every 3+1 constant-B case.

title: Schwinger effect with backreaction in 1+1D massive QED with a strong external field
type: Primary research; November 2025 preprint with 2026 journal publication
read_depth: Read abstract, treatment description and stated semiclassical-comparison result in full-text HTML; not independently recomputed bosonized expansion.
role: A concrete fully quantum benchmark exhibits an order-m oscillation-frequency correction missed by usual semiclassical backreaction.
limitation: Strong-field perturbation in mass in 1+1 dimensions; neither exact all-mass solution nor direct validation of 3+1 Landau mean-field dynamics.
